description: One resumable production run of E3-SSE: ESTIMATE -> DIAGNOSE -> CORRECT OR ABSTAIN -> SELECT -> DISCOVER. Scientific rules come from the active protocol; this file binds inputs, stage order and evidence locations. resource_policy and resource_profiling are operational and never enter the run identity.

runtime.note: model_runtime_root matches configs/study1_softening_atlas.json; on aiserver it resolves to /home/soft/.venvs for the account that created the frozen environments. tmpdir is resolved against outputs_root and keeps temporary files off the RAM-backed /tmp.

freeze.note: existing_binding null: the freeze stage materializes the internal freeze from the clean HEAD after preflight passes; once a freeze exists and the code moves on, pin it here as {protocol_id, file_sha256, directory}. require_outcome_runners_implemented true: the freeze waits until every outcome-reading stage has a tested runner, so no analysis code is written after outcomes are seen; setting it false is a declared deviation recorded with the run.

resource_policy.rationale: The reserve is the larger of 2.5 GiB and 12% of RAM (orchestrator, page cache, load spikes); swap is never capacity. Peak RSS is planned at 1.35x the measured VmHWM. NUMA pinning is not applied: the memory budget, not memory bandwidth, bounds concurrency on this host, and placement never changes results.

stages.name: runtime_audit
stages.description: ASE/FIRE/NEB identity and frozen-settings acceptance audit in every frozen model runtime (no data, no model).

stages.name: resource_profile
stages.description: Measured worker memory and process x thread throughput per model for force single points and the ML-NEB band, on geometry-only structures.

stages.name: gate1_population_audit
stages.description: Outcome-free structural bookkeeping at d = 3 (evidence for open items rate_limiting_hop_algorithm and prospective_gate1_rule): unique normalized chemical systems of the rate-limiting hops in nebDFT2k, one structure per system, published-split classes. Upper bounds, never a population manifest.

stages.name: descriptor_availability
stages.description: Source-field availability of the label-free descriptor set.

stages.name: development_population
stages.description: Development, P and Q unit manifests (Gate 0, owner-decided P = published-train, identity-only weight-fit slices) and the hashed development manifest; identifiers and covariates only.

stages.name: bvse_reproduction
stages.description: Frozen BVSE initial-path generator and its reproduction of nebDFT2k _init.xyz.

stages.name: development_ml_neb
stages.description: Frozen ML-NEB on the development units (every model), migrating-Li embeddings along converged bands, the 20-hop reproducibility rerun and the LiTraj-exact sensitivity; outcome-free.

stages.name: path_representation
stages.description: Per-model z_path by the frozen mapping rule, acceptance (finite, deterministic, environment-sensitive, LOCSO and tau_d degeneracy checks), branch (latent, descriptor, unavailable) and the development support reference; label-free.

stages.name: preflight
stages.description: Aggregate every blocking outcome-free evidence item (Git, data hashes, Gate 1, embeddings, checkpoints, locks, runtimes, ASE/NEB audits, resource profiles, protocol open items, output safety).

stages.name: freeze
stages.description: Materialize (or bind) the frozen internal-freeze protocol from the reviewed clean commit; grants outcome access to later stages.

stages.name: estimate
stages.description: Study-1 softening estimates (Eq. 17), cluster bootstrap, label budget, diagnostics, tables and figures for all six frozen models.

stages.name: pilot
stages.description: Training-only pilot amendment (frozen thresholds bound; simulation MDE from Study-1 training-force estimates) and its internal pilot record; unseals non-training outcomes.

stages.name: family_scale
stages.description: Family softening scales for the deployed predictor.

stages.name: transfer
stages.description: Raw and SRT-corrected fixed-geometry barriers, paired effects and the P1 endpoint.

stages.name: reliability
stages.description: Risk-coverage, AURC and correct-or-abstain behaviour of the pre-outcome diagnostics.

stages.name: weight_slice_ml_neb
stages.description: Every model's frozen ML-NEB on the identity-defined P and Q weight-fit slices (outcome-free): independent support coverage for model selection and the converged slices for the density ratio.

stages.name: model_selection
stages.description: Frozen development-set selection of the deployed model.

stages.name: deployment_calibration
stages.description: Selected model's frozen ML-NEB on the conformal-calibration units (slice excluded), support gate and family SRT or labelled raw, and the relaxed-vs-fixed comparison; no label read (draw -> run -> drop).

stages.name: linear_recalibration_comparator
stages.description: Label-using comparator, kept after model selection.

stages.name: controlled_selection
stages.description: Retrospective conformal FDR validity and power.

stages.name: discovery
stages.description: Prospective pool predictions.

stages.name: density_ratio
stages.description: Density-ratio weights for weighted conformal selection.

stages.name: discovery_selection
stages.description: Controlled prospective selection and candidate evidence.

stages.name: publication
stages.description: Registered publication figures and tables with provenance.

runners.classification: scientific bindings of the stage runners (enter the run identity)

structures.note: The three immutable BVEL13k extxyz shards are the G0-pinned pristine source. material_id is source-provided by the published LiTraj schema; paths are explicit and each file is verified against the G0 input manifest. The same source is used for development, P and Q.

bvse.note: ions 0.4.1 is the release matching LiTraj c3ca5c2 notebooks/bvse_neb.ipynb (exact API; reproduces its Li3PO4 example); build this runtime from its own lock (ions 0.4.1 also needs PyYAML, which it does not declare); the reproduction audit against nebDFT2k _init.xyz confirms or refutes the pin (open items ions_bvse_version_pin, bvse_reproduction); environment_lock pins the runtime's requirements-style lock (name==version lines): the runner verifies its SHA-256 and every installed version of ions, ase, numpy, scipy, spglib, pymatgen, networkx and PyYAML against it
